categories.title: Abandoned Site
categories.info:
Defeat all enemies to liberate the area and repopulate it with locals. 

**Rewards:**
- 120-170 XP
- 50 Crowns

categories.title: Monster Nest
categories.info:
Nests are localized infestations of a single monster type. Destroy the nests with Grapeshot, Dancing Star, or Samum bombs. Often, a stronger "boss" variation of the monster will spawn after the nest is destroyed, which can be killed for bonus XP rewards.


**Rewards:**
- 20 XP
- Random Nest Loot

categories.title: Place of Power
categories.info: Draw from a Place of Power to gain a temporary bonus. The first time you draw from any Place of Power, you also receive 1 Ability Point.

categories.title: Beehive
categories.info:
Honeycomb looted from beehives are very useful for their unusually high sell price with herbalists in White Orchard and Velen. It can be a great source of early game currency.

Use Aard or Igni to clear the bee swarm, then loot the fallen beehive for x1-4 Honeycomb. Beehives can respawn, but the honeycomb inside can only be looted once.
